description: Read the shared Delx wellness profile (~/.delx-wellness/profile.json). Returns the user's preferred name, body basics, goals, devices, training context, nutrition context, agent preferences, and missing critical fields. Cross-connector — the same profile is also available from other Delx Wellness MCPs (WHOOP, Garmin, Nourish, Fitbit, etc). Read-only.
name: oura_profile_get
title: Oura Profile Get (shared wellness profile)
